Error

This error appears when you try to access a tab that is not available in your current business.

There are two possible reasons why you cannot access this tab:

1. The tab has been disabled in the business settings

2. You do not have permission to view this tab

To resolve this issue, you can:

- Contact your administrator to enable the tab under Settings

- Ask your administrator to grant you permission to access this tab

- If you are the administrator, go to Settings and enable the required tab
